title: limniris chrysophylla
intro: Limniris chrysophylla, commonly known as Golden Lilyturf, is a type of flowering plant in the Iridaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Golden Lilyturf include iridoids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, cardiovascular health, and antimicrobial activity. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.
